title: Minimum Numbers of Function Calls to Make Target Array
summary: Given an integer array nums, determine the least number of calls needed to transform an initially zeroed array arr into nums using a specified modify function.
statement: Given an integer array nums, determine the least number of calls needed to transform an initially zeroed array arr into nums using a specified modify function.
constraints: Start with an all-zero array; one call increments any single element by one, and another doubles every element.
Return the minimum calls needed to construct nums.
hints: Each one bit requires one individual increment at the bit position where it is introduced.
All numbers share the global doublings, whose count is one less than the largest bit length.
Reversing the process forces removal of odd units before every simultaneous halving, proving optimality.
editorial: Reversing the process forces removal of odd units before every simultaneous halving, proving optimality.

tests.explanation: Three one-bit increments and two global doublings construct one and five in five calls.
Increment both positions once, then double the whole array, for three calls.
